newsitem.title: LATVIA: Staburadze shares leap on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Staburadze shares leap on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Recent stock market entrant Staburadze starred on the Latvian bourse on Thursday as trade in its shares outstripped other stocks and its price leapt.
The confectionery firm had traded little since its debut nine days ago as huge demand failed to find sellers. But today 46,000 lats of stock was traded and the price rose to 2.09 lats from 1.82.
It was by far the most traded stock on the market, where overall turnover came to 69,946 lats.
Leading bank Unibanka turned over 4,030 lats and dipped to 2.20 lats from 2.33 lats.
Also on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet slipped one santime to 99 on trade of 1,166 lats.
The Daugavpils chain maker was again the most active stock on the secondary list with volume of 7,252 lats and it dipped to 1.07 lats from 1.16 lats.
Other active stocks were the Lode Brick company on turnover of 5,530 lats as it stayed unchanged at 1.02 lats while the drinks firm Veldze traded 2,190 lats and gained to 73 santimes from 68.
